name: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk.
summary: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk. engages in the mining and processing of nickel, cobalt, and other mineral deposits in Indonesia and China. It operates through Mining, Manufacturing, and Others segments. The company manufactures non-ferrous basic metals; and collects hazardous waste. It also engages in the limestone industry and quarrying; generation, transmission, distribution, and sale of electricity; electric power plant operation; gravel quarrying; holding company activities; management consulting activities; and support activities for other mining and quarrying.
